span.p:
isVisibleToPublic: only an explicit false hides
the project and its media from guest reads.
Update may cascade it to media isPublic.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
removedAt + removedBy = soft-trash; the same audit
block sits on Project and Category. Listing, restoring
or purging trash requires the entity:delete authority.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Standalone branding row.
No FK, no soft-trash, no @Version.
